spans.s:
m. (-वः)
A Kaurava, a descendant of KURU.
E.
कुरु, and अण् affix; also with वुञ् affix कौरवक.

m. (-व्यः)
An ancestor or descendant of KURU.
E.
कुरु, and ण्य aff.

mfn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मी-र्म्मं)
1 Relating to a tortoise.
2 Acting as a tortoise.
3 Belonging or relating to the Avatar of VIṢṆU, as a tortoise, as the Kaurmma or Kūrma Purāṇa.
E.
कूर्म्म, and अण् aff.
